user.title: Main Configuration
user.description: Configure the core entities for your smart thermostat.

data_description.name: Name displayed for the climate entity in Home Assistant.
data_description.heater: Switch, valve, light, or number entity controlling heating (Required).
data_description.target_sensor: Temperature sensor measuring the room temperature (Required).
data_description.cooler: Optional actuator used when cooling mode is active.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Optional outdoor sensor used for Ke compensation.
data_description.ac_mode: Switch the main actuator to cooling mode instead of heating.

data_description.min_temp: Leave blank to use Home Assistant default value.
data_description.max_temp: Leave blank to use Home Assistant default value.

presets.title: Preset Temperatures
presets.description: Set temperatures associated with predefined modes (Leave blank to disable a preset).

data_description.preset_sync_mode: Automatically activates a preset if its temperature is selected.
data_description.boost_pid_off: Forces PID mode to OFF when Boost preset is active.

pid.title: PID Controller
pid.description: Configure PID controller gains and PWM period.

data_description.ke: Gain applied to the difference between target and outdoor temperature.
data_description.pwm: Full cycle time for pulse-width modulation regulation (required, set to 0 for analog actuators such as valves, thermostats...).
data_description.keep_alive: Periodically re-sends command to the actuator.

advanced.title: Advanced Settings
advanced.description: Cycle protection, output limits, and safety behavior.

data_description.output_precision: Number of decimal places for output.
data_description.output_min: Absolute minimum output value applied to actuator.
data_description.output_max: Absolute maximum output value applied to actuator.
data_description.min_cycle_duration: Minimum duration between two actuator state changes (ON and OFF if min_off_cycle_duration is not specified).
data_description.min_off_cycle_duration: Minimum duration in OFF state for actuator.

data.force_off_state: Force Actuator Off When Thermostat is Off

data_description.min_cycle_duration_pid_off: Minimum cycle duration when PID is disabled.
data_description.min_off_cycle_duration_pid_off: Minimum off cycle duration when PID is disabled.
data_description.sensor_stall: Timeout before falling back to safety output value if sensor stops responding.
data_description.output_safety: Output percentage applied if sensor is stalled or offline.
data_description.invert_heater: Enable if the actuator must be turned off to heat (e.g., inverted relay).
data_description.force_off_state: Ensures actuator is physically turned off when HVAC mode is OFF.

error.output_min_max: Must be output_min <= out_clamp_low < out_clamp_high <= output_max.
error.min_max_temp: Minimum temperature must be lower than maximum temperature.
error.target_temp: Target temperature setpoint must be between minimum and maximum temperature.
